verdicts.reason: A: in the 320x50 strip, the two pills are bigger than the CTA, which is pushed against the top-right edge, so the hierarchy is wrong. The body copy is microscopic and the can is shrunk to a tiny icon. B is worse: the CTA, pills and body copy are all squeezed into a cramped right-hand stack that you can't read, and the CTA is the smallest element of all. Both keep the headline readable on the left but cram far too much in.
